payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is a helmet visibly present on the woman’s head?
node.criteria: For R1, complete if s1 passes. Partial only if s1 fails and s2 passes, establishing both no completed helmet-on-head result and visible incomplete helmet-related progress. Absent if s1 and s2 both fail. Unknown if these states do not establish complete, partial, or absent; in particular, s1 unknown with s2 pass remains unknown. Unrelated edits do not count as progress; insufficient evidence remains unresolved.
